title: The critical mixed-arithmetic four-point HRT theorem
summary: Although the Heil--Ramanathan--Topiwala conjecture is false in full generality, its failure makes the classification of positive geometric and arithmetic regimes more urgent. We settle the critical mixed-arithmetic regime for four time-frequency shifts. For \(z=(x,ω)\) and \(w=(y,η)\), set \(σ(z,w)=xη-yω\). Let \(u,v\in\R^2\) satisfy \(\lvertσ(u,v)\rvert=1\), write \(ν=αu+βv\), and assume that \(0,u,v,ν\) are distinct. If \(\dim_{\Q}\operatorname{span}_{\Q}\{1,α,β\}=2\) then, for every nonzero \(f\in L^2(\R)\), the vectors \(f,π(u)f,π(v)f,π(ν)f\) are linearly independent. This includes both…
